title: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance and surface temperature
licence: USGS data policy; confirm product-specific terms and attribution
spatial_resolution: Thermal surface-temperature product distributed on a 30 m grid; native thermal measurement resolution differs by sensor
temporal_coverage: Archive coverage depends on satellite generation and scene availability
intended_use: Historical land-surface temperature patterns and optical indicators after QA masking
limitations: Land-surface temperature is not near-surface air temperature, indoor temperature, personal exposure, or clinical heat risk. Cloud, emissivity, atmospheric correction, overpass time, and resampling affect interpretation.

title: Sentinel-2 Multi-Spectral Instrument Level-2A
licence: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; retain attribution and verify applicable conditions
spatial_resolution: 10 m, 20 m and 60 m depending on spectral band
temporal_coverage: Global archive from 2015 onward; usable observations depend on cloud and scene coverage
limitations: Optical reflectance is not a direct measure of shade quality, tree health, access, water availability, or cooling benefit.

title: WorldPop gridded population estimates
licence: Check the licence and citation requirements for the selected country-year product
spatial_resolution: Product-dependent; selected products include approximately 100 m grids
temporal_coverage: Country and year availability varies by product and estimation method
intended_use: Approximate population distribution for exposure screening
limitations: Modelled population surfaces are estimates, not household counts or real-time population. Avoid treating small-area differences as exact.

title: Global Human Settlement Layer
licence: Check the selected layer's dataset-specific licence and citation
spatial_resolution: Layer-dependent, including gridded population and built-up products
temporal_coverage: Multi-epoch products; exact years vary by layer
intended_use: Independent built-up and population context and cross-checking
limitations: Global modelled products may smooth local settlement detail and differ from national statistics.

title: OpenStreetMap Malawi extract
provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; extract distribution by Geofabrik
licence: Open Database Licence (ODbL); attribution and share-alike obligations apply to qualifying derivative databases
spatial_resolution: Feature-level vector data; completeness and positional quality vary by feature and location
temporal_coverage: Continuously edited; extract timestamp must be recorded at download
intended_use: Candidate buildings, roads, amenities, green spaces and public infrastructure
limitations: Coverage is uneven and community-mapped. Missing features do not prove absence. Validate critical assets with local sources.

title: Malawi administrative boundary datasets
provider: National Spatial Data Centre and other authoritative national custodians, subject to confirmation
licence: Not yet confirmed; obtain source-specific permission and attribution terms before redistribution
spatial_resolution: Vector administrative units; hierarchy and scale depend on the supplied dataset
temporal_coverage: Version and effective date must be obtained from the data custodian
intended_use: Boundary definition and aggregation units after authority and geometry checks
limitations: Do not assume a district, city council, planning-area or functional urban boundary represents the same geography. Authority and currency require confirmation.

title: ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis
licence: Copernicus Climate Data Store licence and attribution requirements
temporal_coverage: 1950 to near-present, with product-specific update latency
intended_use: Regional meteorological context and seasonal background, not neighbourhood-scale temperature mapping
limitations: Grid spacing is too coarse to resolve street-level urban heat variation. Reanalysis values are model-based estimates, not local station observations.
